forecourt.k: The arena, the keynote hall and the breakout rooms · Sunfield
forecourt.p: The main arena of the Sunfield campus: a low, wide hall wrapped in a folded skin of weathered copper and desert sandstone, with a glazed lobby facing the forecourt and a curved LED media wall over the doors. Inside: the Grand Lobby, a keynote hall that seats about four and a half thousand, and two breakout rooms. Walk in through the glass doors.

lobby.k: Registration, wayfinding and the way into the keynote hall
lobby.p: Check in at the registration desk, then follow the signs: the Keynote Hall is straight ahead through the three portals, the breakout rooms are down the side corridors to the left and right.

watch.p: Take a seat in the house and watch the keynote on the main stage.

hall.k: About 4,500 seats · main stage, layered LED walls, a lighting rig
hall.p: A flat floor in front of the stage and raked tiers behind it, aisles with steps between the sections. The side walls are red sandstone, the ceiling is folded copper. Find an aisle seat and press E to sit and watch.

breakA.p: A room for about a hundred and twenty: workshops, panels and working sessions alongside the main programme.

maren.name: Maren
greet: Welcome to the Sunfield Convention Center.
Good to see you. The keynote is on in the main hall.
Hello there. Grab a badge and head on in.

talk.t: Welcome to the Sunfield Convention Center, the main arena of the Sunfield campus. I look after the lobby. What can I help you with?

The Sunfield Summit. The keynote is running in the main hall right now, straight ahead through the three portals. Take any aisle seat and press E to sit and watch, or use the Watch the keynote point by the portals and we will seat you in the middle of the house.

It is a low, wide arena wrapped in folded panels of weathered copper and desert sandstone, so it glows orange at sunset. The LED wall over the doors shows the summit, the community impact counter and, after dark, the night sky. The keynote hall seats about four and a half thousand people.
Down the side corridors. The Mesa Room is to the north, the Canyon Room to the south. Each one seats about a hundred and twenty for workshops and panels.

theo.name: Theo
greet: Great to have you in the room.

talk.t: Welcome to the Sunfield Summit. Today is about building in the desert: communities, aviation, and giving that is built into how things run, not added on afterwards.
How a place like Genesis grows into a living community, and how every visit, flight and conversation here adds to the shared impact counter you can see on the LED wall outside.
